title: Shared facts definitions
description: The shapes that Memex.User and Memex.Contacts share, from @tjalve/memex-facts. See contracts/facts.md.

seen.description: When the evidence was observed: the first and the last time. It says nothing about when the fact was true.

method.description: The rule or model and its version, for example rule:trip-nearness/2 or card:vcard/1.

generation.description: Goes up with each run of the producer. A hub refuses a write with a lower generation than the last one of the scope or partition.

origin.description: What gave a value: a claim, or a correction.

fieldPath.description: A field name, or <field>/<index> for one element of a list field.

provenance.description: For each field, and each element of a list field, the claims or the correction that gave it.

value.description: The value that the record does not show.

reason.description: weaker: a stronger claim or a correction won. coarser: the bound of a claim at a coarser precision. conflict: partial dates that do not refine each other. suggested-end: an end that a later record in another town suggests; the engine never sets it.

alternatives.description: For each field, the values that lost. They stay, so that a reader or the person can choose one.

reviewReason.description: Why a record is on the quiet review list.

listEdit.description: The value of a list field in a set correction that edits the list instead of replacing it. Claims can still add elements; a removed element does not come back.

heldReason.description: Why a hub stored a correction and did not apply it. not-merged is for Memex.Contacts only.
